subject.title: fix(skills): reject skill downloads exceeding 100 MB

question: Is 100 MiB the intended supported maximum for direct skill download artifacts?
rationale: Moving enforcement into the stream is technically clear, but selecting a new fixed cutoff changes previously accepted installer behavior and requires owner intent or compatibility evidence.

options.title: Approve 100 MiB with evidence
options.body: Confirm this ceiling and show that supported direct-download skill artifacts remain below it.

options.title: Choose another fixed ceiling
options.body: Select a threshold from supported artifact inventory while retaining in-stream enforcement.

options.title: Pause the cutoff change
options.body: Defer the PR until the direct-download artifact-size contract is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve 100 MiB with evidence
recommendation.body: Confirm this ceiling and show that supported direct-download skill artifacts remain below it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the skill lifecycle path and related archive-size policy.
